phase_title: Phase 15-8 receiver_validator_permission 測定ワークフロー実行可否判定設計
phase_purpose: Phase 16 検証結果受領（Phase 17-1）を完了した上で、Phase 15-8（receiver_validator_permission 実測判定）測定ワークフローを実行してよいかの最終判定を行うための設計。Phase 16 結果の有効性、現在の NOT_EFFECTIVE 状態確認、ブロッキング条件チェック、システム安定性確認を組み合わせた最終ゲートを設計する。Phase 17-2 と並行実行、または Phase 17-2 の後に順序実行できるよう設計。
execution_context: reports-only design phase; design of Phase 15-8 measurement workflow execution feasibility judgment structure only, no actual workflow execution yet

governance.safety_rule: All blocked_actions remain strictly prohibited. Phase 15-8 measurement workflow execution feasibility judgment is design-only; no actual Phase 15-8 workflow execution occurs. No app/tests implementation permitted.
governance.hard_stop_condition: This phase is design-only. No actual Phase 15-8 measurement workflow is executed.

phase15_8_measurement_workflow_execution.purpose: Determine whether Phase 15-8 (receiver_validator_permission measurement) workflow can execute, based on: (1) Phase 17-1 Phase 16 result receipt confirmation, (2) current receiver_validator_permission state (NOT_EFFECTIVE), (3) Phase 16-3 blocking conditions, (4) system stability and data availability
phase15_8_measurement_workflow_execution.judgment_timing: Immediately after Phase 17-1 result receipt and consistency confirmation is finalized (typically same time or after Phase 17-2)
judgment_inputs: Phase 16-3 overall_feasibility_assessment (READY_1_VALIDATION_PASSED, READY_2_PRECONDITIONS_MET, READY_WITH_CAUTION, or NOT_READY)
Current integrated_decision state (should still be NO_GO at Phase 17-3 entry; may change during Phase 17-2)
Current system readiness (no active production deployments, no drift)
judgment_outputs: Phase 17-3 Phase 15-8 measurement workflow execution feasibility judgment determining: PROCEED_TO_PHASE_15_8_MEASUREMENT, HOLD_PENDING_AUTHORITY_DECISION, or HALT_DO_NOT_EXECUTE_PHASE_15_8

gate_1_phase16_result_receipt_confirmati.requirement: Phase 17-1 overall_phase16_result_receipt_status must be RECEIPT_CONFIRMED_AND_CONSISTENT or RECEIPT_CONFIRMED_WITH_WARNINGS
gate_1_phase16_result_receipt_confirmati.logic: IF receipt_status IN [RECEIPT_CONFIRMED_AND_CONSISTENT, RECEIPT_CONFIRMED_WITH_WARNINGS] THEN gate_1_PASS ELSE gate_1_FAIL
gate_1_phase16_result_receipt_confirmati.if_fail: Phase 16 results incomplete or inconsistent; cannot proceed to Phase 15-8 measurement
gate_1_phase16_result_receipt_confirmati.rationale: Phase 16 design must be complete and consistent before Phase 15-8 can measure

gate_2_phase17_1_next_action_non_blockin.requirement: Phase 17-1 recommended_next_action_for_phase_17 must be PROCEED or PROCEED_WITH_CAUTION (not DO_NOT_PROCEED)
gate_2_phase17_1_next_action_non_blockin.logic: IF action IN [PROCEED, PROCEED_WITH_CAUTION] THEN gate_2_PASS ELSE gate_2_FAIL
gate_2_phase17_1_next_action_non_blockin.if_fail: Phase 17-1 recommends halting; cannot proceed to Phase 15-8 measurement
gate_2_phase17_1_next_action_non_blockin.rationale: If Phase 17-1 advises halt, Phase 15-8 must not execute

gate_3_phase16_3_feasibility.requirement: Phase 16-3 overall_feasibility_assessment must be READY_1_VALIDATION_PASSED or READY_2_PRECONDITIONS_MET (or READY_WITH_CAUTION if authority approved)
gate_3_phase16_3_feasibility.logic: IF feasibility IN [READY_1_VALIDATION_PASSED, READY_2_PRECONDITIONS_MET] THEN gate_3_PASS; IF READY_WITH_CAUTION AND authority_approved THEN gate_3_PASS; ELSE gate_3_FAIL
gate_3_phase16_3_feasibility.if_pass: Phase 16-3 confirms readiness for Phase 15-8 measurement
gate_3_phase16_3_feasibility.if_fail: Phase 16-3 indicates not ready; Phase 15-8 measurement cannot proceed
gate_3_phase16_3_feasibility.rationale: Phase 16-3 identifies blocking conditions that would prevent Phase 15-8 execution

gate_4_receiver_validator_permission_not.requirement: Current receiver_validator_permission status must be NOT_EFFECTIVE (not already EFFECTIVE or other state)
gate_4_receiver_validator_permission_not.logic: IF current_receiver_validator_permission == NOT_EFFECTIVE THEN gate_4_PASS ELSE gate_4_FAIL
gate_4_receiver_validator_permission_not.if_pass: receiver_validator_permission is in NOT_EFFECTIVE state; Phase 15-8 can attempt measurement
gate_4_receiver_validator_permission_not.if_fail: receiver_validator_permission is already EFFECTIVE or other state; measurement bypass detected
gate_4_receiver_validator_permission_not.rationale: Phase 15-8 is designed to measure and potentially change NOT_EFFECTIVE → EFFECTIVE; pre-existing EFFECTIVE state indicates anomaly or prior execution

gate_5_phase16_3_blocking_conditions.requirement: All blocking conditions from Phase 16-3 must be inactive or explicitly waived by authority
gate_5_phase16_3_blocking_conditions.reference: Phase 16-3 lists 6 blocking conditions: 1) receiver_validator_implementation_change, 2) app_implementation_drift, 3) tests_implementation_drift, 4) external_api_unauthorized, 5) cron_scheduled_changes, 6) active_production_deployment
gate_5_phase16_3_blocking_conditions.logic: IF blocking_conditions_count == 0 OR all_active_conditions_explicitly_waived THEN gate_5_PASS ELSE gate_5_FAIL
gate_5_phase16_3_blocking_conditions.if_pass: No blocking conditions for Phase 15-8 measurement
gate_5_phase16_3_blocking_conditions.if_fail: Blocking conditions present; Phase 15-8 cannot safely execute
gate_5_phase16_3_blocking_conditions.rationale: Blocking conditions indicate system incompatibilities with measurement; receiver_validator_implementation_change particularly affects Phase 15-8

gate_6_integrated_decision_state_observa.requirement: Current integrated_decision state should be observed but is not a blocking condition for Phase 15-8 (Phase 17-2 may have changed it)
gate_6_integrated_decision_state_observa.logic: Observe current integrated_decision state; if still NO_GO (unchanged from Phase 17-2 entry), continue; if changed to GO (Phase 17-2 executed and changed it), continue with notation; if unexpected state, flag as warning
gate_6_integrated_decision_state_observa.if_pass: integrated_decision state is consistent with expected progression (NO_GO → maybe GO after Phase 17-2)
gate_6_integrated_decision_state_observa.rationale: Phase 17-2 may have changed integrated_decision during concurrent or prior execution; Phase 15-8 execution is independent but state awareness is important for logging and audit trail

decision_rule_gates_must_pass.rule: Gates 1-5 must pass for Phase 15-8 to execute (gate 6 is observational, not blocking)
decision_rule_gates_must_pass.logic: IF (gate_1 AND gate_2 AND gate_3 AND gate_4 AND gate_5) THEN overall_feasibility = PROCEED_TO_PHASE_15_8_MEASUREMENT ELSE determine_halt_or_hold
decision_rule_gates_must_pass.rationale: Each blocking gate represents critical execution precondition; all must be satisfied for safe Phase 15-8 execution

decision_rule_gate_failure_categorizatio.rule: If any blocking gate fails, categorize failure type and determine halt or hold

failure_type_1_phase16_blocking.action: Phase 16 results invalid or Phase 17-1 advises against proceeding; Phase 15-8 must not execute

failure_type_2_readiness_gaps.action: Escalate to authority; list readiness gaps and blocking conditions; await decision
failure_type_2_readiness_gaps.can_proceed_after: Authority explicitly approves proceeding despite gaps, or gaps resolved

failure_type_3_state_inconsistency.action: Investigate state inconsistency; check if Phase 15-8 already executed; check if Phase 17-2 caused unexpected side effects
failure_type_3_state_inconsistency.can_proceed_after: State consistency restored or Phase execution order clarified

elements.blocking_gates_passed: Count of blocking gates (1-5) that passed
elements.blocking_gates_failed: Count of blocking gates (1-5) that failed
elements.gate_6_integrated_decision_observation: Current integrated_decision state observed (for audit trail)

elements.phase16_3_feasibility_status_received: From Phase 16-3: READY_1_VALIDATION_PASSED | READY_2_PRECONDITIONS_MET | READY_WITH_CAUTION | NOT_READY
elements.authority_approval_for_caution: If status is READY_WITH_CAUTION: approved by authority? boolean

elements.failure_reason_if_fail: If gate failed, why (e.g., 'receiver_validator_permission is already EFFECTIVE')

elements.critical_condition_for_phase15_8: receiver_validator_implementation_change is particularly critical for Phase 15-8
elements.explicitly_waived_conditions: List of conditions that are present but explicitly waived
elements.failure_reason_if_fail: List of blocking conditions preventing execution

elements.expected_state_at_phase17_3_entry: NO_GO (if Phase 17-2 not yet executed) or GO (if Phase 17-2 executed and measured GO)
elements.state_consistency_with_phase17_2: Observation comparing current state with Phase 17-2 execution order
elements.flag_if_unexpected: If integrated_decision state is unexpected (e.g., CONDITIONAL), flag with warning for investigation

logic.PROCEED_TO_PHASE_15_8_MEASUREMENT: All 5 blocking gates PASS; Phase 15-8 measurement workflow can execute immediately
logic.HOLD_PENDING_AUTHORITY_DECISION: Some blocking gates failed, but failures are not critical; require human authority decision to proceed or halt
logic.HALT_DO_NOT_EXECUTE_PHASE_15_8: Critical blocking gates failed (Phase 16 blocking or state inconsistency); Phase 15-8 must not execute

authority_decision_required.description: Is human authority judgment required to proceed with Phase 15-8?
authority_decision_required.condition: true if overall_feasibility is HOLD_PENDING_AUTHORITY_DECISION; false if PROCEED or HALT

phase15_8_handoff_condition.description: State at the moment Phase 15-8 (receiver_validator_permission measurement) can enter

elements.phase15_8_can_execute: boolean - true if PROCEED_TO_PHASE_15_8_MEASUREMENT or authority approved
phase15_8_entry_preconditions: phase16_3_feasibility_status: READY (Phase 16-3 READY_1 or READY_2 or CAUTION_APPROVED)
blocking_conditions_status: CLEARED (Phase 16-3 GATE_5 PASS or WAIVED)
elements.phase15_8_entry_timestamp: Time at which Phase 15-8 begins (if approved)
elements.phase15_8_measurement_objective: Measure receiver_validator_permission state using evidence from actual_measurement_input_data; determine if should be EFFECTIVE or remain NOT_EFFECTIVE based on measurement evidence
elements.concurrent_with_phase15_7: Phase 15-8 may execute concurrently with Phase 15-7 or sequentially after; both measure independent states

example_1_proceed.scenario: All Phase 16/17-1 receipts confirmed, Phase 16-3 ready, no blockers, state correct
example_1_proceed.gate_6_integrated_decision_observation: OBSERVATION: NO_GO (if before Phase 17-2 completes) or GO (if Phase 17-2 executed)

example_2_hold_blocker_present.scenario: Phase 16 confirmed, Phase 16-3 ready, but receiver_validator_implementation_change detected
example_2_hold_blocker_present.reason: receiver_validator implementation changed; measurement may be invalid
example_2_hold_blocker_present.next_action_if_approved: Proceed to Phase 15-8 with understanding that implementation change may affect measurement

example_3_halt_phase16_failed.reason: Phase 16 results invalid; Phase 15-8 cannot proceed
example_3_halt_phase16_failed.next_action: Investigate Phase 16/17-1 issues before attempting Phase 15-8

example_4_halt_state_inconsistency.reason: State inconsistency: receiver_validator_permission should be NOT_EFFECTIVE at Phase 17-3 entry; if already EFFECTIVE, Phase 15-8 already executed
example_4_halt_state_inconsistency.next_action: Investigate state change; check execution logs; clarify system state

depends_on: Phase 17-1: Phase 16 result receipt and consistency confirmation (provides receipt_status and recommended_action)
Phase 16-3: Pre-decision update feasibility assessment (provides overall_feasibility_assessment and blocking_conditions)
Phase 15-8 current state snapshots (to verify NOT_EFFECTIVE)
Phase 17-2 (optional, can be concurrent): Phase 15-7 measurement workflow execution feasibility (shares Phase 17-1 input)
feeds_into: Phase 15-8: receiver_validator_permission measurement workflow (receives PROCEED or HALT decision)
Phase 15-7 (concurrent or sequential): Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 measure independent states using the same Phase 16 validated input

design_review_checklist: Five blocking gates + one observational gate designed (total 6)
Gate 6 is observational (logs integrated_decision state for audit trail)
Phase 16 receipt failures (gates 1-2) result in HALT_DO_NOT_EXECUTE_PHASE_15_8
Report structure includes all gate evaluations and overall feasibility result
Handoff condition for Phase 15-8 explicitly defined with receiver_validator_implementation critical check
Examples cover PROCEED, HOLD_BLOCKER, HALT_PHASE16, and HALT_STATE scenarios
Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 independence documented (concurrent or sequential execution possible)
All blocked actions remain in governance

completion_gate.gate_condition: Phase 15-8 measurement workflow execution feasibility judgment design approved AND gate evaluation logic finalized
completion_gate.approval_required: Human technical reviewer + Phase 17 design authority + Phase 15-8 measurement workflow authority
completion_gate.prerequisite_for: Once Phase 17-1, 17-2, 17-3 designs are approved, Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 measurement workflows can execute (concurrently or sequentially)
